title: 01 · Halden Private: private banking home
strengths: One hero figure (£4,862,310.54 in Bodoni with smaller pence) above an axis-free chart, then holdings rows with tabular figures and a second line for the change: the rhythm Revolut and Wealthsimple use, rebuilt in its own materials.
Believable data: a balanced-mandate portfolio, a sterling current account ending 0921, £12,480 of £60,000 spent this month, a 1M range picker.
Platform chrome is right: 9:41 status bar, a four-item labelled tab bar, 44 pt targets, gold held to one job (delta, chart, active tab).
slop_signals: The card stacks brushed-metal gradient, contour-line guilloche, noise and engraved text shadows: the 'luxury fintech card' cliché. Revolut and Monzo show premium cards as flat colour with a logo.
The brand is said four times on one screen: the 'HALDEN PRIVATE' wordmark, 'HALDEN RESERVE' on the card, the 'H' monogram, 'Holdings' in the same Bodoni.
Letterspaced capitals carry 'premium' on the wordmark, the card name, 'ELEANOR VOSS' and '4417': tracking used as decoration.
The next card peeks in as a plain gold rectangle with no detail, so it reads as a cut-off block rather than a second card.
fixes: Flatten the card: one green, the chip, the wordmark and the number; drop the contour pattern and the specular sheen.
Say the brand once: keep the wordmark, drop the monogram, set 'Holdings' without letterspacing.
Give the peeking card a visible detail (its own name or last digits) or remove the carousel.

references.what: Cards shown as small flat thumbnails above 'Total wealth'; the balance leads, not the card.
The card is one flat colour with the balance on it, and the feed below uses plain rows with amounts right-aligned.
Dark home with a big balance over an axis-free area chart and range pills: the same hero rhythm, with no texture anywhere.
Dark invest home: 'Holdings' as a plain section head and a tab bar with five labelled items.
